author: Adam Savage’s Tested
description:
In order to get his 3000 lumen Firesword flashlight working again, Adam has to recreate its power button by precisely machining an exact copy based off one borrowed from a friend. It all stars with a pair of calipers and sketching out all of its measurements. 

Find out more about the Firesword flashlight here: http://elektrolumens.com/FireSword-V/FireSword-V.html

Shot by Adam Savage and edited by Norman Chan
Music by Jinglepunks
